description: The line chart, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of different model variants of MS-FSLHate on the HateXplain dataset, with the x-axis representing five distinct model configurations: "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The y-axis measures the evaluation metrics—precision, recall, and F1-score—in percentage (%), ranging from 58% to 66%, with gridlines at 2% intervals. The legend indicates that the purple line with circular markers represents Precision, the blue line with circular markers represents Recall, and the tan line with circular markers represents the F1-score. The "Full model (Ours)" achieves the highest scores for all three metrics, with Precision at 65.45%, Recall at 65.78%, and F1-score at 65.56%. The "w/o Prompt" variant shows a significant drop in all metrics, with Precision at 61.06%, Recall at 59.64%, and F1-score at 60.16%. The "w/o Augmentation" variant shows a peak in Recall at 64.06%, with Precision at 62.22% and F1-score at 62.63%. The "w/o Attention" variant shows a drop in all metrics, with Precision at 64.06%, Recall at 59.17%, and F1-score at 59.67%. The "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" variant shows the lowest scores, with Precision at 65.44%, Recall at 56.82%, and F1-score at 57.74%.
